status: Three visual variations requested; selection pending. No main HTML or Unity layout changes.

variants.name: coin-hero
variants.title: Coin hero
variants.prompt: Create ONE finished high-quality PORTRAIT MOBILE GAME UI design variation of the AFK/offline earnings popup for Rocket Raja, inspired by the supplied CURRENT GAME SCREEN. The screenshot contains a desktop review sidebar on the LEFT: completely ignore and omit that sidebar and its controls. Output ONLY a tall portrait game viewport, roughly 390 by 844 proportions, no browser chrome, no device bezel, no multi-panel montage, no option number on the artwork. Keep a darkened painted Indian fireworks stall subtly visible behind the popup, with the game's Player/Products/Legacy/Shop bottom navigation faintly behind the dim overlay. The POPUP is the clear focus. Preserve the established Gouache Storybook / Ivory Bazaar art direction: textured ivory paper, cobalt blue typography and button, restrained warm gold frame, tiny Indian floral corner accents, marigold warmth, hand-painted coin artwork. One perimeter frame only: no duplicate outer border, no white margin outside the frame. This is the SAME existing screen, redesigned in layout, not new mechanics. VARIATION 1 'Coin hero': A confident, compact centered hero-reward composition. Big painted pile of gold rupee coins in a subtle blue medallion at the top third. Huge clear ₹147.45M centered beneath with the small label 'Offline earnings'. Put Away 10h / Credited 8h / Efficiency 50% into one very clean three-column strip. Beneath it, one narrow gold-highlighted optional bonus ribbon says 'With an ad: ₹294.90M'. Spacious hierarchy, minimal prose, warm ivory paper, crisp cobalt and gold. Footer vertically stacked full-width buttons. Required readable UI text and values: heading 'Welcome back'; BASE reward '₹147.45M'; OPTIONAL doubled reward '₹294.90M'; 'Away 10h', 'Credited 8h', 'Efficiency 50%'. Two bottom actions ONLY, first the strong primary cobalt button labeled exactly 'Watch ad for 2× rewards', second quieter cream button labeled exactly 'Continue'. Keep them easy to read and tap, equal full width, well separated. Small blue OUTLINED CIRCLE with lowercase serif i at the upper LEFT of popup header; blue square close X at the upper RIGHT; reserve clear space so neither overlaps heading. No extra help banner, no extra footer buttons, no countdown, no new currency, no 'claim' button, no irrelevant ad-provider branding. All text must be spelled correctly and crisp. Render an attractive production-quality concept that feels native to the provided game's visual style.
